title: Unfinanced Agreement Charges in the Cash Down — Kestrel Auto Finance Tiers on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Schedule.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements financed through Kestrel Auto Finance, some agreement charges are not financed and are added to the cash down. Which charges are left out of the financing follows the tier of the order's approved contract in Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts.

| Tier of the approved contract | Agreement charges added to the cash down |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier D or Tier E | the documentation fee, the shipping fee and the sales tax charged on the order |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B or Tier C | the documentation fee and the shipping fee charged on the order |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A or Tier A+ | none; every agreement charge is financed |

Each charge is taken as charged on the order net of any reversal of that charge, as the order's money history shows it: the charge entries of that kind less the reversal entries of that kind.

The unfinanced charges are added to the cash down after the down payment credits have been subtracted from the required down payment and that difference held at no less than zero; the sum is rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked examples (hypothetical order: documentation fee $999.00, shipping fee $799.00, sales tax $1820.00 charged; required down payment less credits $1100.00).**

| Tier | Charges added | $1100.00 plus the charges added |
|---|---|---|
| Tier D | $999.00, $799.00 and $1820.00, together $3618.00 | $4718.00 |
| Tier C | $999.00 and $799.00, together $1798.00 | $2898.00 |
| Tier A+ | none | $1100.00 |

**Reversed charges (hypothetical).** If the $799.00 shipping fee on the Tier C order had been posted and then reversed in full, its net is $0.00 and the charges added are $999.00.
